saints.name: St. Eusebius of Vercelli
saints.title: Bishop
saints.shortBlurb: The first bishop of Vercelli, exiled for defending the divinity of Christ against the Arians…
biography: Born in Sardinia around 283 and raised in Rome, Eusebius became the first recorded bishop of Vercelli in northern Italy about 345. He was among the earliest bishops to gather his clergy into a common life of prayer and discipline, joining the monastic ideal to the pastoral office.

At the Council of Milan in 355 he refused to condemn St. Athanasius or to abandon the Nicene faith, and the Arian emperor Constantius II sent him into a harsh exile in the East. Restored under Julian, he labored with St. Hilary of Poitiers to heal the Church of Arianism until his death at Vercelli in 371.
saints.knownFor: Defending Nicene orthodoxy and uniting clergy in common life.
